component.name: G-Diffuser
component.summary: Unofficial PC port of F-Zero X

description.p: G-Diffuser is an unofficial PC port of F-Zero X with the 64DD Expansion Kit, including Course Edit.
No game files are included. You must supply your own legally obtained F-Zero X US rev0 ROM, the Expansion Kit disk image and a 64DD IPL ROM, and drag them onto the first-boot window.
This is an unofficial Flatpak packaging of the upstream Linux release.
